thread:
Eleni Rossi: Starting Sentinel onboarding thread. Goal: align stakeholders, confirm SSO + data scope, and agree a compact 0-30 day plan. Proposing Thu 4/8 8:30am PT for a 30m kickoff. Quick agenda: owners, access, success criteria, blockers.

Marcus Bell: Thu 8:30 works. Need to clarify: Hosted vs Private? Impacts infra prep.

Priyanka Rao (Sentinel): Private (VPC) please 11 sensor telemetry + product docs (~8k) to start. Also SOC2 in scope, small legal checklist.

Jon Park: For Private we'll need allowlist ranges and SAML metadata. Priyanka, do you support Okta?

Priyanka Rao (Sentinel): Yes, Okta SAML. I'll bring the admin and infra contacts in the kickoff invite.

Eleni Rossi: Draft success criteria: 1) Endpoint reachable and authenticated from Sentinel VPC; 2) Initial 8k docs ingested and searchable; 3) Pilot group NPS >= 4/5 after week 2; 4) No critical privacy flags in automated scan. Edit as needed.

Marcus Bell: Add latency target: p95 < 280ms under pilot load. Also I'll propose a small Dedicated reserve for months 0-1, burst to Hosted if required.

Priyanka Rao (Sentinel): Agree on criteria, adding: pilot engagement baseline = 20 DAUs during week 2.

Eleni Rossi: Owner map (draft):
- Sentinel exec sponsor: Priyanka Rao
- Sentinel infra: TBC (Priyanka will confirm)
- Redwood CSM: Eleni Rossi 
- Redwood Solutions: Jon Park -> enablement/workshop
- Redwood Infra: Marcus Bell -> deployment & capacity

Jon Park: I'll prepare a 60-90min enablement for week 2 and a short eval pack (prompts + regressions).

Eleni Rossi: Risks to track: SOC2/legal delays, missing SAML metadata, sample data quality. We'll treat pilot adoption + NPS as the renewal signal.

Priyanka Rao (Sentinel): I'll upload a 1k sample by Tue EOD and confirm infra lead.

calendar-bot: Meeting created: "Sentinel Onboarding Kickoff" Thu Apr 8 8:30am PT 1 invite sent. Link: https://meet.redwood.ai/meet/sentinel-onboard-0408

Marcus Bell: Action items pre-kick: 1) Sentinel to share Okta metadata + allowlist (Tue), 2) sample data upload (Tue), 3) infra lead contact (Mon). I'll post firewall rules + initial capacity estimate after samples.

Eleni Rossi: I'll post a 0-30 owner timeline in this thread by EOD. Please ping me if dates change.

Priyanka Rao (Sentinel): Thanks all, see you Thu. :thumbsup:
